programme.desc: Bella, pelajar universiti di Korea Selatan pulang ke Malaysia untuk menghabiskan cuti semester tetapi ketenangan mula bertukar menjadi huru-hara selepas bertemu dengan lelaki Melayu-Korea bernama Daniel.

programme.title: Jack Yusof Ep5
programme.desc: Jack berasa kecewa bila isteri mudanya, Suzy memutuskan untuk tinggal bersama dia di rumah barunya. Pada masa yang sama, Aida tidak dapat meluangkan masa bersama Zain.

programme.title: Citra Exclusive: Pintu No. 9 Masjid Nabawi
programme.desc: Kisah benar Allahyarham Dato' S. Roomai Noor dan Allahyarhamah Datin Umi Kalsom mengenai saat-saat akhir mereka bersama ketika mengerjakan umrah. Kisah kasih sayang dan kesetiaan hingga hujung nyawa.

programme.title: Bisikan Remaja
programme.desc: Ikuti kisah percintaan remaja antara Amera dan Daniel dan cabaran suka dan duka yang diharungi semasa berada di kolej di ibukota. Lakonan Lisdawati & Zed Zaidi.

programme.title: Korban 44 Ep. 8
programme.desc: Kisah tragik tanah runtuh yang meragut 44 nyawa kaum asli Semai dan diikuti pula dengan krisis pergolakan keluarga Anjang dan Wati.

programme.title: Tilam Perca
programme.desc: Seorang nenek mengatasi pelbagai kesukaran untuk menyayangi cucunya yang ketagih dadah, anak-anaknya yang tidak peduli dan hanya mementingkan wang, serta menantu perempuan yang kejam.

programme.title: Citra Exclusive: Malek
programme.desc: Seorang lelaki yang dikenakan Akta Pencegahan Jenayah hidup sebatang kara setelah dibuang daerah. Namun, segalanya berubah apabila anaknya, Malek muncul secara tiba-tiba setelah isterinya meninggal dunia.

programme.title: Kampong Pisang Bersiri Siri Ep1
programme.desc: Kesinambungan dari filem Mamat Khalid yang berlatar belakangkan Kg Pisang. Tayangan serentak EP 1 di Astro Citra/Citra HD dan Astro Ria/Ria HD. Episod seterusnya hanya di Astro Citra dan Citra HD.

programme.title: The Jurassic Games
programme.desc: Dalam masa terdekat, 10 banduan yang berdepan hukuman mati terpaksa bersaing dalam permainan realiti maya yang mempertemukan mereka dengan dinosaur dan satu sama lain.

programme.title: Akinabalu Ep5
programme.desc: Ikuti kisah percintaan tiga segi antara Berida, Edward & Andili dan usaha mereka dalam membantu membebaskan tahanan tentera Australia dari cengkaman tentera Jepun.

programme.title: From Saga With Love S1 Ep7
programme.desc: Karma diambil bekerja semula oleh Bianca apabila Bob berhenti kerja. Sham tiba di Malaysia dan menumpang di rumah Bob. Bianca semakin hampir untuk menjayakan projek travelognya.

programme.title: Konstabel Mamat
programme.desc: Mamat, seorang konstabel polis digantung tugas selama tiga bulan kerana cuai semasa menjalankan tugas. Namun begitu, dia masih berjaya menumpaskan beberapa kegiatan jenayah semasa tempoh penggantungannya.

programme.title: Akim & Mira - Kisah Cinta 1999 Ep10
programme.desc: Mira enggan lagi bertemu dengan Akim dan memilih untuk berpisah.

programme.title: Dayang Senandong
programme.desc: Kisah mengenai Dayang Senandong, seorang gadis yang disumpah menjadi hitam mengahwini seorang putera raja, namun dibenci oleh ibu mertuanya kerana kehodohannya.

programme.title: Cubit-Cubit Cinta
programme.desc: Kupid Cubit adalah sebuah 'dating app' yang sepatutnya memudahkan orang ramai untuk menemui cinta. Tetapi bagi Katarina dan Saiful, mereka menggunakannya untuk mengubat hati yang bertepuk sebelah tangan.

programme.title: Citra Exclusive: Penjara Abah
programme.desc: Natasha merupakan seorang kanak-kanak pintar namun dinafikan hak belajar oleh ayahnya. Dengan bantuan Cikgu Atok, Natasha berjaya bersekolah namun ada harga yang harus dibayar.

programme.title: Manisnya Cinta Di Cappadoccia
programme.desc: Kisah konflik Ifti Liyana yang terpaksa berdepan dengan cinta tiga lelaki iaitu Fredo, Bahkhtiar dan Nazmi.

programme.title: Jack Yusof Ep6
programme.desc: Suzy cuba menjadi suri rumah yang baik namun Jack sangka mereka tidak serasi. Suzy kemudiannya menolong Aida dalam persiapan perkahwinan, di mana Jack dan Rahmat berasa ragu-ragu tentang kebolehan Zain.

programme.title: Ayat Dari Langit
programme.desc: Ustaz Muiz dan isterinya mengajar ajaran sesat dan mahu pengikutnya mengikut telunjuk mereka yang lama kelamaan mula membuatkan pengikutnya bernama Kamal mula merasa sangsi.

programme.title: Senja Merah
programme.desc: Sebuah filem Melayu yang diterbitkan di Malaysia dalam tahun 1982 arahan Allahyarham Hussein Abu Hassan lakonan Allahyarham Latif Ibrahim, Jamaliah Arshad dan ramai lagi.

programme.title: Sepenggal Puisi Ep1
programme.desc: Rahsia yang di simpan selama 30 tahun akhirnya terbongkar dan menimbulkan konflik dalam 2 buah keluarga yang berada di Kuala Lumpur dan juga Yogyakarta.

programme.title: Syaaban
programme.desc: Mengenai seorang lelaki yang sanggup mengubah dirinya untuk mengahwini wanita idamannya.

programme.title: Tayangan Perdana Keluarga Iskandar
programme.desc: Saksikan musim baru drama siri Keluarga Iskandar S3 setiap Jumaat hingga Ahad jam 9 malam di saluran Astro Ria. Dibintangi oleh Kismah Johar, Susan Lancaster, Zain Ruffedge dan ramai lagi.

programme.title: Tanah Kubur
programme.desc: Tok Adi cuba menyiasat kejadian pelik yang berlaku ke atas beberapa orang yang tinggal di daerah yang berbeza dan langsung tiada kaitan.

programme.desc: Amelia terkejut apabila mengetahui bahawa Rafeeq mungkin tidak bersalah, meretakkan hubungannya dengan Zaid, Iqbal dan Akid. Amelia merasa kusut dalam menangani masalah ketika acara sekolah bermula.

programme.title: Confidential Assignment 2: International
programme.desc: N. Korea detective returns for another secret mission. Despite having different underlying motives, 3 countries join forces to bring down an international crime organization.

programme.title: 71: Into the Fire

programme.title: Samjin Company English Class

programme.title: Wok Cooking On A Charcoal Grill
programme.desc: Anything is possible with a wok and a good ol’ charcoal grill, at least if you’re Chef Dale, who throws together a heavenly spread of fiery eats, from drunken meats, stir fried veggies, and stir fried noodles

programme.title: Caribbean Latin BBQ
programme.desc: Comforting and familiar but full of island flavor, right from the grill! Chef Dale roasts pork shoulder with chicharrones, steamy coconut rice and pigeon peas finished with frozen coconut rum drank with a charred banana.

programme.title: World of Burgers!
programme.desc: It’s burger day! Chef Dale tackles three classics with a full flavor spin. Game changing Pho Burgers with bone marrow, toasted milk bread Ahi Tuna patty melts, and Chori Pan Burgers with a fried egg and shrimp chips.

programme.title: Grilled Loco Moco and Huli Huli Chicken
programme.desc: The options are plentiful when Chef Dale smothers grilled Loco Moco with a mushroom gravy, salty and sweet Huli Huli Chicken with charred pineapple, and healthy scoops of Tuna Water Chestnut poke or mac salad.

programme.title: Street Eats off the Grill
programme.desc: Japan, Thailand, Turkey, and Mexico street foods inspire Dale to grill with dynamically preparing Chili-Cuman Lamb Mushroom sticks, Grilled pork and shrimp shumai, and scallion pancakes with brown butter labneh.

programme.title: Weeknight Noodles

programme.title: Pho, Poke, & Pig in O’ahu
programme.desc: Frankie explores Hawaii's O’ahu island to get nourished from fresh tuna poke, heartfelt Pho, and hand-pounded poi.

programme.title: Quail, Alligator Sausage, & Gumbo in New Orleans
programme.desc: Frankie stops by New Orleans to chow down on lacquered quail, a beast of a Po Boy, and Creole Beef Daube.

programme.title: Cubanos, Empanadas, & Smoked Beef Rib in Miami
programme.desc: Frankie goes to Miami to sample serious cherry smoked beef rib, three cheese spinach empanadas, and a legendary Cubano sandwich with homemade mustard.

programme.title: Chiles, Burgers, & Tenderloins in Santa Fe
programme.desc: Frankie heads to Santa Fe investigating New Mexican cuisines eating green chili burgers, poblano chile stews, and sweet blue-corn pancakes.

programme.title: Scrumptious Summer Sandwiches
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde channels his inner sandwich lover by making an angry lobster club with pepper aioli and grilled bacon, a lamb birria torta with avocado and ramen consomme, and his an Italian beef combo with chili crisp cheese sauce, and giardiniera.

programme.title: Sunday Vietnamese Brisket with Noodles
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde shows us how he does Sunday up right as he grills up some Vietnamese Brisket with Rice Noodles, Crispy Swordfish Summer Rolls, and tops it all off with some tasty Soju Floats. Hey, it’s Sunday somewhere, right?

programme.title: Bougie Badass Burgers
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde brings your basic burgers to a new level with his dry-aged beef burger with potatoes and truffle dijon mayo, a part-beef part-pork belly burger with cheddar & an egg, and lastly a crispy mushroom tortilla burger with salsa & cheese.

programme.title: The Perfection of Pork
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde brings the heat when it comes to making perfect pork dishes including a root beer glazed pork banh mi, chorizo fried rice, Filipino sausage stuffed long hot peppers, and round it all out with a spicy grilled pineapple sundae.

programme.title: Wok Cooking On A Charcoal Grill

programme.title: Luxe Lobster & Prime Rib
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde pulls out all the stops for this daddy-sized dinner. He grills up prime rib with herb & horseradish crust, lobster & chili sauce American, charred green beans with garlic tahini, and cheddar-stuffed parker house rolls.

programme.title: Caribbean Latin BBQ
programme.desc: Comforting and familiar but full of island flavor, right from the grill! Chef Dale roasts pork shoulder with chicharrones, steamy coconut rice and pigeon peas finished with frozen coconut rum drank with a charred banana.

programme.title: Sizzlin' Summer Fruits
programme.desc: Summertime seasonal fruit pampers your tastebuds. Chef Dale grills blistered grapes with ham wrapped Trout, Peaches with smoked Pork Chops, Watermelon with halloumi, and Chargrilled Cherries with chocolate Mousse.

programme.title: Tempting Tasty Tacos
programme.desc: It’s always taco night at Chef Dale’s house! He turns up the heat with grilled salmon tacos with salsa verde & cauliflower escabeche, duck al pastor tacos with habanero pineapple salsa, & a smokey mushroom queso taco with truffle mole negro.

programme.title: Deluxe Dogs with Crusted Corn & Potatoes
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde puts a modern spin on a classic All-American cookout with his loaded hot dogs, spiced smashed potato salad, chorizo & corn nut crusted corn, and bangin’ banana pudding pops. Sparklers out for this spread!

programme.title: Pasta From Scratch
programme.desc: Frankie explores his Italian roots, pairing each pasta shape with its perfect sauce—from Cavatelli with Super Green Sauce to Pappardelle in pork ragout, ricotta Gnocchi with punchy anchovy pecorino, and cozy Squash Orzotto with bloomed poppy seeds.

programme.title: Italian Smokehouse
programme.desc: Frankie fires up a steakhouse-style spread with Italian flair from golden beets and buttery mushrooms to a sizzling Bistecca alla Fiorentina steak with salmoriglio sauce, and a smooth cold brew affogato granita.

programme.title: Lunch That Goes the Distance
programme.desc: Frankie fuels up for action making hot Oatmeal, and Energy Date Balls, before he cooks up the perfect post-ride feast of cheesy Juicy Lucy Burgers, Ramp-loaded pasta salad, and a maple ginger switchel to cool it all down.

programme.title: Getting the Band Back Together
programme.desc: Frankie reunites his old band for a jam session and a spin on a college-era classic — featuring Shoyu Ramen with Tare Eggs, sweet and savory Chicken Meatballs, Seaweed Cucumber Salad, and a crispy Okonomiyaki pancake.

programme.title: The Wonderful World of Pizza
programme.desc: Frankie makes pizza magic with two incredible doughs, turning his kitchen into a pizza party with grilled sausage pizza, cheesy Grandma Pies, golden Panzerotti, and a sweet dessert pizza topped with ricotta, berries, and honey.

programme.title: Beef Shank is the New Brisket
programme.desc: Kevin and Noah are smoking a humungous Thor’s Hammer; cooking up some Catfish & Eggs for breakfast; making a Grilled Salsa Verde; and putting on a pot of Mezcal Charro Beans.

programme.title: The Secret to World-Class Texas Brisket
programme.desc: Kevin and Noah are making brisket 3 ways! They’re pit-smoking a classic Texas brisket; showing you how to gussy up a pot of Brisket Baked Beans; and making a charcoal-grilled Vietnamese Brisket Noodle Bowl with all the fixings.

programme.title: Why LA’s "Danger Dog" is the Best Thing You’ll Ever Eat

programme.title: Joys of Jamaican Cooking
programme.desc: Stephanie challenges herself to learn more about Caribbean food. Meeting with home cook Kat Williams, who teaches her about Jerk chicken and the art of rice and peas and then restaurant owner Chef Tony who shows her the secret to oxtail.

programme.title: Middle East Street Food Eats
programme.desc: Stephanie highlights the diversity of Middle Eastern cuisine through the lens of street food. Cooking Pakistani kebabs with home chef, Izza Khan, and then learning the complexity of Israeli street food at Dr. Sandwich.

programme.title: Stephanie and the Pitmaster
programme.desc: Stephanie joins UPS driver and home chef, Fernando Carrillo, for a backyard BBQ and a trip to LA institution Carnitas el Momo to learn the subtle art of slow cooking and the techniques of flavor.

programme.title: Legacies and Thai Cuisine
programme.desc: Stephanie cooks Thai and Peruvian dishes with home chef Brittaney Bunjong and swaps stories about growing up in the kitchen with their moms. Rediscovering the joys and influence of those flavors on her own cooking.

programme.title: Side Hustles
programme.desc: From a lawyer to an actor to an insurance analyst, Stephanie discovers a world of folks who’ve turned their passion for cooking into side hustle food businesses. From dumplings, sushi and pretzels she explores how they balance their day jobs.

programme.title: Comfort Foods
programme.desc: Latin-inspired ice cream to Caribbean, Channa curry doubles to gourmet, deli sandwiches; Stephanie Izard shows what comfort food means to 3 very different cooks and learns how they turned their childhood memories into thriving food businesses.

programme.title: Cooking with Fire
programme.desc: Stephanie meets 3 cooks who use fire in different ways to create distinct dishes. Using their love of cooking over an open flame; these cooks introduce her to the diverse flavors of Armenia; a classic Italian hero, and infrared grilled Brazilian BBQ

programme.title: Secret Pizza
programme.desc: With the help of a guide, Stephanie Izard explores the underground secret pizzas of Los Angeles, including an off-menu pizza at a cinnamon bun pop-up, apartment-cooked limited drop specials and gourmet sourdough pies made in pizza van’s mobile oven.

programme.title: Life After Restaurants
programme.desc: From backyard mariscos to Cantonese remixes of British hand pies to made-to-order slap noodles, Stephanie catches hangs with 3 chefs who left the traditional restaurant scene and found alternative ways to cook for a living and make the food they love

programme.title: Farm Forward Cooking

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Scruffts
programme.desc: Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".nnBut they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Birkenhead, Inspector Anthony Joynes is accompanied by the police to attend an unlocked and empty property. Inside he finds Teddy, the terrified Terrier cross that has a flea infestation so bad that he's missing half his fur. One-year-old Teddy is incredibly nervous, but will he be able to overcome his fears and allow the RSPCA to offer him help?

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The Japanese animated film My Neighbor Totoro, which is popular all over the world is the childhood memory of many. Totoro's classic furry body, round eyes and cute expression are very endearing. In South America, there is a kind of chinchilla that looks very similar to Totoro in the film. I heard that Taiwan now allows legal imports of these animals for breeding! Today, let’s follow the Totoro zoo owner Molly and fall in love with the soft and cute charm of this animation star!

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've scoured the internet clean to bring you the most entertaining puppy clips out there: overexcited pups, pilfering pups, pups who fall asleep in their dinner bowls, puppy vloggers, driving pups, and even a look at the latest craze: pups who go into a quivering frenzy at the sight of-K doorstoppers.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: A crazy animal expert raises hundreds of pets in their workplace; the super cute characteristics and breeding secrets of pet turtles are revealed; elementary school students' favorite beetle army attacks, tailor-made insect jelly taste super delicious; and animal therapist is now on duty, "Cute Pet Guide" takes you to visit a parent-child farm and get close to various cute pets.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Sulcata tortoises are the third largest land tortoise in the world, native to the Sahel Corridor in Africa. They do not come from the desert!!! They need to take baths and drink water too!!!nThey are 5 to 7 centimeters tall at birth, with bright black eyes that are super attractive. They grow really fast when healthy, adults can reach 0.9 meters in size and live over 100 years. But they will easily catch a cold and get sick if you are not careful. How to keep your turtles healthy? Let’s hear what the experts say!

programme.desc: Tormented by his criminal past, Clean attempts a quiet life caring for his community and as a mentor to his young neighbor Dianda. When local gang violence puts his neighbor’s life in danger, Clean finds himself returning to his violent past.

programme.title: Centigrade
programme.desc: A married couple find themselves trapped in their frozen vehicle after a blizzard and struggle to survive amid plunging temperatures and unforeseen obstacles.

programme.title: Override
programme.desc: In 2040, a female humanoid A.I. is hacked by her husband and forced to kidnap the U.S. vice president's son and execute him on live television.

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Tormented by his criminal past, Clean attempts a quiet life caring for his community and as a mentor to his young neighbor Dianda. When local gang violence puts his neighbor’s life in danger, Clean finds himself returning to his violent past.

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: Based on the true story, Edgar Valdez, drug lord and cartel leader, is betrayed by one of the brothers. Seeking retribution, Valdez will risk it all to gain control of the Feliz cartel.

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: After planning a perfect heist, Nick is ready to score. One problem, his girl and the crew, have other ideas. They take Nick down in a hail of bullets but Nick doesn't die and in a race for his life, seeks revenge one target at a time.

programme.title: Blindfire
programme.desc: A police officer who while responding to a violent hostage call, kills the African American suspect only to later learn of his innocence. Sensing this was a set-up, and facing repercussions, he must track down the person responsible while examining his own accountability and the ingrained racism which brought him to this point.

programme.title: In Isolation
programme.desc: Four friends wanted to get away from it all in a remote country house but when a mysterious injured man turns up on their doorstep telling tales of a city ravaged by a epidemic and the looters who have pursued him, the friends rally to help.

programme.title: The Commando
programme.desc: A DEA agent returns home with PTSD after a botched mission and must now protect his family from a home invasion when a recently freed convict and his henchmen come after their stash of millions hidden inside of the agent's home.

programme.title: Hunting Games
programme.desc: Two dangerous armed men must hunt each other and fight to death over millions of dollars in cash in this high octane wilderness survival story.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: Following a violent raid on her outpost, a British nurse, Anne is on the run with a small group of soldiers. She must balance bravery with compassion to save a native girl, her husband, and her colony.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep3
programme.desc: Ep03 Roz kembali beraksi setelah lama bersara, dengan bantuan Ejen Mah. Dia sampai ke lokasi yang disangkakan Rin ada di situ, malangnya pihak polis dan Daniel juga sampai ke situ. Daniel menyerang Roz kerana dia sangka Roz adalah penculik. Roz cuba melindungi identitinya sebagai seorang perisik.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep4
programme.desc: Ep04 Roz, Datin Seri dan Ejen Mah kembali beraksi untuk menolong Roz menyelamatkan cucunya, Rin. Mereka dapat mengesan lokasi sebenar Rin dan menyelamatkannya sebelum Daniel dan polis tiba. Rin kini tahu identiti sebenar Opah Roz.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep5
programme.desc: Ep05 Kegembiraan Roz dapat menyelamatkan Rin terbantut apabila penculik Rin telah melepaskan diri daripada tahanan polis. Roz juga mengaitkan kes penculikan Rin dengan kes Dr Kaos Jr yang terlepas dari penjara dengan rancangan jahat yang lebih besar.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep6
programme.desc: Ep06 Roz dan Rin diserang. Dia menjejak para penyerangnya ke pangkalan rahsia mereka. Ejen Mah dihantar untuk menyiasat tetapi dia ditangkap. Roz, Datin Seri dan Rin bekerjasama membebaskan Ejen Mah dan Roz dapat mengalahkan Nora, ketua penculik. Tetapi Dr Kaos Jr telah maju selangkah dan bereksperimen dengan senjata barunya.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep1
programme.desc: Eps 01 Roz menjalani kehidupan normal sebagai seorang opah setelah pencen dari kerjaya lamanya iaitu ejen perisik. Suatu hari, cucunya Rin, telah menggodam satu permainan komputer dan dia dihubungi oleh seorang misteri dalam talian yang mengetahui identiti Rin. Roz mengesyaki sesuatu tidak kena, tapi malangnya Rin telah diculik oleh penjahat misteri tersebut sebelum Roz sempat bertindak.

programme.title: Geng Gajet S1 Ep1
programme.desc: Aly dan geng di perkenalkan kepada Ramona, yang memerlukan bantuan mereka untuk merakam video untuknya, yang sebagai gantinya, berjanji akan membuat video promo untuk kedai ayah Aly

programme.title: Geng Gajet S1 Ep2
programme.desc: Mesin pencetak kedai Bob tiba-tiba rosak dan perlu diperbaiki. Aly dan geng mesti bergabung bersama untuk memperbaikinya untuk pelanggan. Namun, Nabil dan Eu Jin tidak hadir kerana mereka obses terhadap "Akses Premium" untuk permainan yang mereka mainkan.

programme.title: Geng Gajet S1 Ep3
programme.desc: Mesin pencetak kedai Bob tiba-tiba rosak dan perlu diperbaiki. Aly dan geng Seorang pelanggan mencabar Aly untuk membuat produk untuknya, di mana dia belajar dengan bantuan rakan-rakannya apa yang diperlukan untuk merancang & membina penemuan baru sambil tetap teratur dan fokus.

programme.title: Geng Gajet S1 Ep4
programme.desc: Ramona meminta bantuan Geng untuk menjadi influencer terkenal, di mana Aly dan geng membantunya membuat filter baru menggunakan kod mereka. Melalui usaha mereka, Ramona mempelajari bagaimana sikap pengguna dalam talian, sekaligus Aly dan geng membantu Ramona menghadapi masalahnya.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep5

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep6
programme.desc: Ep06 Roz dan Rin diserang. Dia menjejak para penyerangnya ke pangkalan rahsia mereka. Ejen Mah dihantar untuk menyiasat tetapi dia ditangkap. programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep1
programme.desc: Eps 01 Roz menjalani kehidupan normal sebagai seorang opah setelah pencen dari kerjaya lamanya iaitu ejen perisik. Suatu hari, cucunya Rin, telah menggodam satu permainan komputer dan dia dihubungi oleh seorang misteri dalam talian yang mengetahui identiti Rin. programme.desc: The story of an extraordinary woman and her incredible life.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E07 - Sold into Slavery
programme.desc: Ivan está investigando el comercio ilegal de carne de caza en Kinshasa, cuando se topa con tres crías de chimpancé cautivas que se venden en el mercado negro. Se planea un dramático rescate en el que los chimpancés son entregados sanos y salvos a un lugar dedicado a proporcionar un futuro mejor a todos los primates de África.

programme.title: Dropped - S01:E06 - Exploration Camp
programme.desc: The guys continue to push down river. Exhausted and starving, the brothers have barely enough energy to set camp. The guys discover is that sign is plentiful and the topography lends itself to moose habitat.

programme.title: Dropped - S01:E07 - Prayer Point
programme.desc: By the third day of moving along the river, everyone really needed a hunting camp to lift their spirits and keep pushing towards the goal of taking down a big bull. Tensions ran high and for the first time, the brothers confessed they were at a loss on how to proceed.

programme.title: Wardens - S02:E02 - Operation Antler Blitz
programme.desc: Montana Game Wardens investigate stolen antlers and join in conservation activities for sage grouse and walleye.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E07 - Iraqi Sniper Attack
programme.desc: Durante su despliegue en la provincia de Anbar, el sargento mayor del Cuerpo de Marines Buck Doyle se pone en peligro para salvar a un compañero caído a manos de un francotirador iraquí y se convierte él mismo en objetivo.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E08 - Lightning Strike
programme.desc: Una excursión de pesca de lubina sale terriblemente mal cuando un rayo cae en su barco, dejando a Christian Neal, de diecisiete años, quemado e inconsciente y a su padre Gabe volando al agua y paralizado. Se necesitará un milagro para salvarlos.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E01 - Terry's Criminal Mind
programme.desc: A murderer tries to kill his final victim as the car they are in slowly sinks to the bottom of a lake. The only way to save the victim is to rescue her as the car continues to sink. We test fire multiple handguns underwater to see if you can actually penetrate a car windshield and save the victim.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E02 - Shark Go Boom!
programme.desc: In Jaws, Chief Brody hangs on to his sinking boat as a giant shark approaches him with a scuba tank lodged in its mouth. We construct a giant shark on a motorized platform to test if you can hit, and explode, the tank with an M1 Garand rifle while perched in a precarious position.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E09 - Queen Camilla
programme.desc: The documentary Queen Camilla? takes a closer look at Camilla Parker-Bowles, covering her history, her life, and what lies ahead. programme.desc: Ivan is investigating the illegal trade of bush meat in Kinshasa, when he stumbles upon three captive baby chimpanzees being sold on the black market. A dramatic rescue is planned that sees the chimps safely delivered to a place dedicated to providing a better future for all primates in Africa.

programme.title: Dropped - S01:E06 - Exploration Camp
programme.desc: The guys continue to push down river. Exhausted and starving, the brothers have barely enough energy to set camp. The guys discover is that sign is plentiful and the topography lends itself to moose habitat.

programme.title: Dropped - S01:E07 - Prayer Point
programme.desc: By the third day of moving along the river, everyone really needed a hunting camp to lift their spirits and keep pushing towards the goal of taking down a big bull. Tensions ran high and for the first time, the brothers confessed they were at a loss on how to proceed.

programme.title: Wardens - S02:E02 - Operation Antler Blitz
programme.desc: Montana Game Wardens investigate stolen antlers and join in conservation activities for sage grouse and walleye.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E07 - Iraqi Sniper Attack
programme.desc: On deployment in Anbar Province, Marine Corp Master Sergeant Buck Doyle throws himself in harms way to save a fallen comrade from an Iraqi sniper and becomes a target himself.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E08 - Lightning Strike
programme.desc: A bass fishing trip goes horribly wrong when a bolt of lightning strikes their boat, leaving Seventeen-year-old Christian Neal burned and unconscious and his father Gabe blown into the water and paralyzed. It will take a miracle to save them.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E01 - Terry's Criminal Mind
programme.desc: A murderer tries to kill his final victim as the car they are in slowly sinks to the bottom of a lake. The only way to save the victim is to rescue her as the car continues to sink. We test fire multiple handguns underwater to see if you can actually penetrate a car windshield and save the victim.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E11 - Royal Children Prince William and Prince Harry
programme.desc: Two young men who have had to cope with extraordinarily challenging events and circumstances as, together, they have gone on to change the face of the British royal family and carve meaningful roles for themselves in the modern world. Made in 1999 two years after the death of their mother, Princess Diana, this original and touching documentary examines the lives of the royal princes, the legacy of their mother, the responsibilities of being a royal - and what the future holds for them.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S02:E08 - The Forgotten Giants
programme.desc: Not all poaching is for horns and tusks. In many parts of poverty-stricken Africa, giraffes are killed mercilessly for their meat. Ivan joins a specialized team in exploring radical solutions to both save the giraffe and provide food to communities in need.

programme.title: Dropped - S01:E08 - King Of The Tundra
programme.desc: Casey sees a huge bull on the other side of the river and takes it down about 10 yards from the water. Then, another bull comes up the river towards the fallen one. Casey and this bull face off, staring each other down from opposite sides of the river.

programme.title: Dropped - S01:E09 - The Day After
programme.desc: After taking down a huge bull, Chris and Casey manage to cut up the 1500-pound moose just as night is about to set in. They then set up a meat storage solution to keep the food good for the rest of their trip.

programme.title: Wardens - S02:E03 - Operation Waterfall
programme.desc: Snow in Montana makes the water dangerous, but the yearly boat float goes on. Watch Montana Game Wardens as they check the rivers to keep boaters safe and following the rules.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E09 - Mountain Lion Attack
programme.desc: Marine Anne Hjelle was mountain biking when she was ripped off her bike by a mountain lion. Anne fought back even as the big cat shredded her face in its jaws. Surviving the attack was only the beginning of Anne's incredible fight to survive.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E10 - Soul of a Survivor
programme.desc: Craig DeMartino examines the stories of other survivors he's met across the season. Their survival stories are all different, but Craig discovers that these survivors share more in common than you might think.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E03 - The Good, The Bad and Terry
programme.desc: In this classic western, Clint Eastwood - aka "Blondie" - saves Eli Wallach from the hangman's noose three separate times by shooting and severing the rope that he hangs from. We recreate each scene and test the reality of these shots with the weapons that were used.
